meta.name: architecture-patterns
meta.description: Implement proven backend architecture patterns including Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design. Use this skill when designing clean architecture for a new microservice, when refactoring a monolith to use bounded contexts, when implementing hexagonal or onion architecture patterns, or when debugging dependency cycles between application layers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用成熟模式搭建后端架构,消除层间依赖纠缠
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为后端代码的层与依赖关系头疼
copy.tagline_en: Design clean backend architecture and eliminate tangled dependencies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are struggling with layered architecture and dependency cycles in your backend.

howto.what: 当你要设计或重构后端服务时,Claude 会按整洁架构、六边形架构等模式拆成分层结构,说明依赖方向与接口定义,并示范用内存对象写单元测试;遇到依赖循环、控制器过重等结构问题,也会给修改建议。
howto.when: 当涉及新微服务的整洁架构设计、把单体按有界上下文拆分、实现六边形或洋葱式分层等架构任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把用户服务按整洁架构分层,给出目录结构和依赖方向。
say.note: Claude 会给出层级划分与接口边界。

say.text: 拆这个单体前,帮我划出有界上下文,标出哪些模块可能互相拖累。
say.note: 它会帮你分析领域边界。

say.text: 把这个用例的测试改成用内存仓储,不要连数据库。
say.note: 对应技能里的测试示例。

howto.what_en: Given a backend service or module, Claude creates a Clean/Hexagonal/DDD layered structure with dependency rules and interfaces, demonstrates in-memory use-case tests, and suggests fixes for circular imports or controller bloat.
howto.when_en: Triggers when designing clean architecture for a new microservice, refactoring a monolith into bounded contexts, or implementing hexagonal/onion style layering.

say_en.text: Structure the user service with Clean Architecture; show layers and dependencies.
say_en.note: You get clear layers and interface boundaries.

say_en.text: Before splitting the monolith, identify bounded contexts and risky couplings.
say_en.note: You will get context boundaries and relationship analysis.

say_en.text: Rewrite this use-case test to run on an in-memory repository, no real database.
say_en.note: Matches the Testing section's in-memory adapter example.
